# Figure_1. Protein profiles of TB patients before, during, and after successful treatment (n=33)

This Quarto document loads cytokine data, performs data pre-processing,
performs PCA by stimulation (Figure_1A), PCA by visit (Figure_1B), and
makes radar plots (Figure_1C).

# Load packages

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(DataExplorer)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(fmsb)
library(scales)    
```

# Define paths

```{r paths}
# Input
excel_file <- "Input/Cytokines_cleaned_log10_Predict-TB.xlsx"

# Output
pca_stim_output_path  <- "Output/01. Figure_1/1A_PCA_all stimuli"
pca_visit_output_path <- "Output/01. Figure_1/1B_PCA_by_visit"
radar_output_path     <- "Output/01. Figure_1/1C_Radar_plots"

# Create all output directories upfront
dir.create(pca_stim_output_path,           recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(pca_visit_output_path,          recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(radar_output_path,              recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load-data}

head(all_data)
```


# Check variance

```{r variance-check}
# sapply over named cytokine_cols to clean, name-based, no positional indexing
variances <- sapply(protein_data[, cytokine_cols], var, na.rm = TRUE)
print(round(variances, 4))
```

# Remove cytokines with low variance

```{r variance-filter}
variance_threshold <- 0.01

cytokine_cols_filtered <- names(variances[variances > variance_threshold])

# Report removed columns
removed_low_var <- setdiff(cytokine_cols, cytokine_cols_filtered)
if (length(removed_low_var) > 0) {
  message("Removed (low variance): ", paste(removed_low_var, collapse = ", "))
} else {
  message("No cytokines removed due to low variance.")
}

pca_data <- protein_data %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, Condition, all_of(cytokine_cols_filtered))

cytokine_cols <- cytokine_cols_filtered   # update reference list

cat("Cytokines retained:", length(cytokine_cols), "\n")
names(pca_data)
```

# -- Figure_1A: PCA by stimulation --

# PCA function

```{r pca-stim-function}
perform_PCA_stim <- function(
    data,
    Visit_value,
    Condition_levels,
    pca_dimensions    = c(1, 2),
    condition_colours = c(
      "Null"   = "#000000",
      "Mtb_Ag" = "#E69F00",
      "LPS"    = "#0072B2",
      "IL1B"   = "#C77CFF"
    ),
    save_path = pca_stim_output_path,
    width     = 6,
    height    = 4,
    dpi       = 300
) {
  
  # Detect quali.sup positions by name
  quali_sup <- which(names(data) %in% c("ID1", "Visit", "Condition"))
  
  # Subset and factorise
  pca_subset <- data %>%
    filter(Visit == Visit_value) %>%
    mutate(Condition = factor(Condition, levels = Condition_levels)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  cat("Visit:", Visit_value, "| n =", nrow(pca_subset), "\n")
  
  # PCA
  respca <- PCA(
    pca_subset,
    scale.unit = TRUE,
    graph      = FALSE,
    quali.sup  = quali_sup
  )
  
  # Scree plot
  scree_plot <- fviz_screeplot(respca, addlabels = TRUE) +
    ggtitle(paste("Scree plot |", Visit_value))
  print(scree_plot)
  
  # Variance table (first 5 dimensions)
  print(get_eig(respca)[1:5, ])
  
  # Biplot
  biplot <- fviz_pca_biplot(
    respca,
    axes        = pca_dimensions,
    habillage   = pca_subset$Condition,
    addEllipses = TRUE,
    invisible   = "quali",
    label       = "var",
    select.var  = list(cos2 = 0.7),
    point_size  = 2,
    repel       = TRUE,
    ggtheme     = theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = 15),
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 16)
      )
  ) +
    ggtitle(paste("log10 PCA |", Visit_value)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = condition_colours) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = condition_colours)
  
  print(biplot)
  
  # Save
  filename <- paste0("biplot_", Visit_value, ".png")
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(save_path, filename),
    plot     = biplot,
    width    = width,
    height   = height,
    dpi      = dpi
  )
  message("Saved: ", file.path(save_path, filename))
  
  # Return PCA object AND plot for downstream access
  invisible(list(pca = respca, biplot = biplot))
}
```

# -- Figure_1B: PCA by visit_temporal trajectories (Mtb_Ag stimulation) --
# Filter Mtb_Ag stimulation
```{r filter-mtb-ag}
pca_visit_data <- pca_data %>%
  filter(Condition == "Mtb_Ag") %>%
  arrange(ID1, Visit)   # critical: ensures correct W0 to Wx path direction

cat("Subjects :", n_distinct(pca_visit_data$ID1), "\n")
cat("Visits   :", paste(sort(unique(pca_visit_data$Visit)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Total obs:", nrow(pca_visit_data), "\n")
```


# Build W0-W72 reference subset, in paired subjects only

```{r build-reference-subset}
# Only keep subjects present at both W0 and W72
v0.72_data <- pca_visit_data %>%
  filter(Visit %in% c("W0", "W72")) %>%
  group_by(ID1) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%       
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(ID1, Visit)

cat("Subjects with W0 & W72:", n_distinct(v0.72_data$ID1), "\n")
cat("Total observations    :", nrow(v0.72_data), "\n")

# Separate metadata from cytokine matrix to prevent metadata leaking
pca_meta_72   <- v0.72_data %>% select(ID1, Visit, Condition)
pca_matrix_72 <- v0.72_data %>% select(all_of(cytokine_cols))
```

# Subset-specific variance filter
```{r subset-variance-filter}
subset_variances_72 <- sapply(pca_matrix_72, var, na.rm = TRUE)

# Apply threshold
subset_variance_threshold <- 0.01

cytokine_cols_visit <- names(
  subset_variances_72[subset_variances_72 >= subset_variance_threshold]
)

# Report removed columns
removed_in_subset <- setdiff(cytokine_cols, cytokine_cols_visit)

cat("\nCytokines removed (low variance in Mtb_Ag W0+W72 subset) \n")
if (length(removed_in_subset) == 0) {
  cat("None removed.\n")
} else {
  cat(paste(removed_in_subset, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  cat("Variances of removed cytokines:\n")
  print(round(subset_variances_72[removed_in_subset], 6))
}

cat("\nCytokines retained for reference PCA:", length(cytokine_cols_visit), "\n")

# Apply filter to PCA matrix
pca_matrix_72_clean <- pca_matrix_72 %>%
  select(all_of(cytokine_cols_visit))
```



# Reference PCA (W0 vs W72)

```{r reference-pca}
n_active_vars <- ncol(pca_matrix_72_clean)
cat("Active variables:", n_active_vars, "\n")
cat("Setting ncp     :", n_active_vars, "\n\n")

respca_ref <- PCA(
  as.data.frame(pca_matrix_72_clean),
  scale.unit = TRUE,
  graph      = FALSE,
  ncp        = n_active_vars  
)

fviz_screeplot(respca_ref, addlabels = TRUE, ncp = n_active_vars) +
  ggtitle("Scree Plot: Reference PCA (W0 vs W72 | Mtb_Ag)")
```

# Store reference PCA parameters

```{r store-pca-params}
ref_center   <- respca_ref$call$centre   
ref_scale    <- respca_ref$call$ecart    
ref_loadings <- respca_ref$svd$V         
active_cols  <- names(ref_center)        

cat("Parameters stored from reference PCA:\n")
cat("  Centre vector length :", length(ref_center), "\n")
cat("  Scale vector length  :", length(ref_scale),  "\n")
cat("  Active cytokines     :", paste(active_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```



# Projection function

```{r projection-function}

project_to_ref_pca <- function(data, visits, n_pcs = 3) {
  
  n_visits <- length(visits)
  
  subset_data <- data %>%
    filter(Visit %in% visits) %>%
    group_by(ID1) %>%
    filter(n() == n_visits) %>%    # only subjects with all visits
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(ID1, Visit)
  
  cat("Subjects with", paste(visits, collapse = " & "), ":",
      n_distinct(subset_data$ID1), "\n")
  cat("Observations:", nrow(subset_data), "\n")
  
  # Select active columns in reference order
  X <- as.matrix(subset_data[, active_cols])
  
  # Center using W0+W72 reference means
  X_centered <- sweep(X, 2, ref_center, "-")
  
  # Scale using W0+W72 reference population SDs
  X_scaled   <- sweep(X_centered, 2, ref_scale, "/")
  
  # Rotate onto reference eigenvectors
  scores        <- as.data.frame(X_scaled %*% ref_loadings[, 1:n_pcs])
  names(scores) <- paste0("Dim.", 1:n_pcs)
  
  scores$ID1   <- subset_data$ID1
  scores$Visit <- subset_data$Visit
  
  return(scores)
}
```

# Verify projection accuracy

```{r verify-projection}

manual_check <- project_to_ref_pca(pca_visit_data, c("W0", "W72"))

direct_scores        <- as.data.frame(respca_ref$ind$coord[, 1:3])
names(direct_scores) <- paste0("Dim.", 1:3)
direct_scores$ID1    <- pca_meta_72$ID1
direct_scores$Visit  <- pca_meta_72$Visit

cat("Projection verification: manual vs direct PCA scores \n")
cat("(|r| must be >= 0.999 for a correct projection)\n\n")

for (pc in paste0("Dim.", 1:3)) {
  r  <- cor(manual_check[[pc]], direct_scores[[pc]])
  ok <- ifelse(abs(r) >= 0.999, "pass", "fail")
  cat(sprintf("  %s: r = %+.8f  %s\n", pc, r, ok))
}
```

# Final score spread check

```{r score-spread-check}

cat("Score spread by visit pair (SD > 0.1 expected on both PC1 & PC2) \n")

score_list <- list(
  "W0-W16" = pca_scores_16,
  "W0-W24" = pca_scores_24,
  "W0-W72" = pca_scores_72
)

for (label in names(score_list)) {
  cat("\n[", label, "]\n")
  score_list[[label]] %>%
    group_by(Visit) %>%
    summarise(
      n        = n(),
      PC1_mean = round(mean(Dim.1), 3),
      PC1_sd   = round(sd(Dim.1),   3),
      PC2_mean = round(mean(Dim.2), 3),
      PC2_sd   = round(sd(Dim.2),   3),
      .groups  = "drop"
    ) %>%
    print()
}
```



# Trajectory plot function
```{r trajectory-plot-function}
plot_pca_trajectory <- function(
    pca_scores,
    visit_colors,
    title,
    pc1_var,
    pc2_var,
    dim_x      = "Dim.1",
    dim_y      = "Dim.2",
    add_arrows = TRUE,
    save_path  = pca_visit_output_path,
    filename   = NULL,
    width      = 5,
    height     = 3.5,
    dpi        = 300
) {
  
  pca_scores <- pca_scores %>% arrange(ID1, Visit)
  
  segment_data <- pca_scores %>%
    group_by(ID1) %>%
    summarise(
      x    = first(.data[[dim_x]]),
      y    = first(.data[[dim_y]]),
      xend = last(.data[[dim_x]]),
      yend = last(.data[[dim_y]]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = .data[[dim_x]], y = .data[[dim_y]])) +
    {if (add_arrows)
      geom_segment(
        data        = segment_data,
        aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend),
        arrow       = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"), type = "closed"),
        color       = "gray40",
        alpha       = 0.5,
        linewidth   = 0.4,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      )
    } +
    geom_point(aes(color = Visit, group = ID1), size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = visit_colors) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    labs(
      x     = paste0(dim_x, " (", pc1_var, "%)"),
      y     = paste0(dim_y, " (", pc2_var, "%)"),
      color = "Visit"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 13)
    )
  
  if (!is.null(filename)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(save_path, filename),
      plot     = p,
      width    = width,
      height   = height,
      dpi      = dpi
    )
    message("Saved: ", file.path(save_path, filename))
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

# -- Figure_1C: Radar plots --
```{r radar-settings}
# Use untransformed data here since Mtb_Ag condition requires subtraction by Null, then log10 transformation.
protein_data_new <- protein_data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cytokine_cols), ~ 10^.x))

# Consistent visit colours across all radar plots
visit_colours <- c(
  "W0"  = "#000000",
  "W16" = "#E69F00",
  "W24" = "#00BFC4",
  "W72" = "#C77CFF"
)

# Axis tick labels: 5 values spanning min to max across 4 segments
radar_axis_labels <- c(-0.1, 1.4, 2.9, 4.4, 5.9)
radar_max         <- 5.5
radar_min         <- -0.1
```

# Radar helper functions

```{r radar-helpers}
# prepare_radar_data: filters condition, computes medians, adds fmsb bounds
# Use for Null condition
prepare_radar_data <- function(
    data,
    condition,
    cytokine_columns,
    max_val = radar_max,
    min_val = radar_min
) {
  sorted_cols <- sort(cytokine_columns)
  
  median_vals <- data %>%
    filter(Condition == condition) %>%
    group_by(Visit) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(cytokine_columns), median), .groups = "drop") %>%
    select(Visit, all_of(sorted_cols)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  cat("Condition:", condition,
      "| Visits:", paste(median_vals$Visit, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  max_row       <- setNames(as.data.frame(matrix(max_val, 1, length(sorted_cols))), sorted_cols)
  min_row       <- setNames(as.data.frame(matrix(min_val, 1, length(sorted_cols))), sorted_cols)
  max_row$Visit <- "Max"
  min_row$Visit <- "Min"
  
  radar_df <- rbind(
    max_row[, c("Visit", sorted_cols)],
    min_row[, c("Visit", sorted_cols)],
    median_vals
  )
  radar_df[, sorted_cols] <- lapply(radar_df[, sorted_cols], as.numeric)
  
  return(radar_df)
}

# Use when custom aggregation is needed (e.g. Mtb_Ag with BDNF = mean)
add_radar_bounds <- function(
    median_data,
    cytokine_columns,
    max_val = radar_max,
    min_val = radar_min
) {
  sorted_cols <- sort(cytokine_columns)
  
  max_row       <- setNames(as.data.frame(matrix(max_val, 1, length(sorted_cols))), sorted_cols)
  min_row       <- setNames(as.data.frame(matrix(min_val, 1, length(sorted_cols))), sorted_cols)
  max_row$Visit <- "Max"
  min_row$Visit <- "Min"
  
  data_ordered <- median_data %>%
    select(Visit, all_of(sorted_cols)) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  radar_df <- rbind(
    max_row[, c("Visit", sorted_cols)],
    min_row[, c("Visit", sorted_cols)],
    data_ordered
  )
  radar_df[, sorted_cols] <- lapply(radar_df[, sorted_cols], as.numeric)
  
  return(radar_df)
}
```

```{r radar-null-data}

  mutate(
    across(all_of(cytokine_cols), ~ log10(.x + 1))
  )
cat("Value range: ",
    round(min(radar_null_data[, cytokine_cols], na.rm = TRUE), 2), "to",
    round(max(radar_null_data[, cytokine_cols], na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")

radar_null   <- prepare_radar_data(
  data             = radar_null_data,   
  condition        = "Null",
  cytokine_columns = cytokine_cols  
)

null_visits  <- radar_null$Visit[-(1:2)]
null_colours <- visit_colours[null_visits]

print(head(radar_null))
```

```{r radar-chart-function}
# Internal drawing function - draws to whatever device is currently active
draw_radarchart <- function(
    data,
    caxislabels,
    color,
    title_text,
    legend_labels,
    fill = FALSE
) {
  op <- par(mar = c(1, 0.5, 2, 0.5))
  
  radarchart(
    data,
    axistype    = 1,
    pcol        = color,
    pfcol       = if (fill) scales::alpha(color, 0.3) else NA,
    plwd        = 5,
    plty        = 1,
    cglcol      = "grey",
    cglty       = 1,
    axislabcol  = "grey",
    caxislabels = caxislabels,
    cglwd       = 0.8,
    vlcex       = 1.3,
    seg         = 4
  )
  
  title(main = title_text, line = -0.5)
  
  legend(
    x        = 0.5,
    y        = -1.2,
    legend   = legend_labels,
    horiz    = TRUE,
    bty      = "n",
    pch      = 20,
    col      = color,
    text.col = "black",
    cex      = 1,
    pt.cex   = 1.5,
    xjust    = 0.5
  )
  
  par(op)
}

create_beautiful_radarchart <- function(
    data,
    caxislabels,
    color,
    title_text,
    legend_labels,
    fill          = FALSE,
    save_path     = NULL,
    width_inches  = 8,
    height_inches = 8,
    dpi           = 300
) {
  
  # Draw to knitr device to appear in HTML
  draw_radarchart(
    data          = data,
    caxislabels   = caxislabels,
    color         = color,
    title_text    = title_text,
    legend_labels = legend_labels,
    fill          = fill
  )
  
  # Save to file separately
  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    if (grepl("\\.pdf$", save_path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      pdf(file = save_path, width = width_inches, height = height_inches)
    } else {
      png(
        filename = save_path,
        width    = width_inches  * dpi,
        height   = height_inches * dpi,
        res      = dpi
      )
    }
    
    draw_radarchart(
      data          = data,
      caxislabels   = caxislabels,
      color         = color,
      title_text    = title_text,
      legend_labels = legend_labels,
      fill          = fill
    )
    
    dev.off()
    message("Saved: ", save_path)
  }
}
```

# Null condition

```{r radar-null-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
create_beautiful_radarchart(
  data          = radar_null[, -1],
  caxislabels   = radar_axis_labels,
  color         = null_colours,
  title_text    = "Median cytokine level_log10 | Null",
  legend_labels = null_visits,
  save_path     = file.path(radar_output_path, "radar_Null.png"),
  width_inches  = 8.33,
  height_inches = 8.33,
  dpi           = 300
)
```

# Mtb_Ag condition: subtracted by Null

```{r null-subtraction}
# Build null reference with _null suffix
null_ref <- protein_data_new %>%
  filter(Condition == "Null") %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, all_of(cytokine_cols)) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_null"), all_of(cytokine_cols))

# Join, subtract null, floor at 0, log10(1+x)
subtracted_log10_data <- protein_data_new %>%
  filter(Condition != "Null") %>%
  left_join(null_ref, by = c("ID1", "Visit"))

for (col in cytokine_cols) {
  null_col <- paste0(col, "_null")
  subtracted_log10_data[[col]] <- log10(
    1 + pmax(0, subtracted_log10_data[[col]] - subtracted_log10_data[[null_col]])
  )
}

# Remove _null columns, add W prefix to Visit
subtracted_log10_data <- subtracted_log10_data %>%
  select(ID1, Visit, Condition, all_of(cytokine_cols))

cat("Dimensions:", nrow(subtracted_log10_data), "x", ncol(subtracted_log10_data), "\n")
cat("Conditions:", paste(unique(subtracted_log10_data$Condition), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("NAs remaining:", sum(is.na(subtracted_log10_data[, cytokine_cols])), "\n")

head(subtracted_log10_data)
```

# Mtb_Ag: median values

```{r mtb-ag-medians}
mtb_ag_data <- subtracted_log10_data %>%
  filter(Condition == "Mtb_Ag")

median_mtb <- mtb_ag_data %>%
  group_by(Visit) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(cytokine_cols), median), .groups = "drop") %>%
  as.data.frame()

# BDNF: replace median with mean (skewed distribution in Mtb_Ag)
mean_bdnf <- mtb_ag_data %>%
  group_by(Visit) %>%
  summarise(BDNF = mean(BDNF), .groups = "drop")

median_mtb <- median_mtb %>%
  mutate(BDNF = mean_bdnf$BDNF)

cat("Median values per visit (BDNF = mean):\n")
print(median_mtb)
```
